description: Get a GATE Daily practice set: ten original GATE CS & IT questions in the exam's format (MCQ, MSQ, NAT; 1 and 2 marks; GATE negative marking), published every day at 00:00 IST. Returns the questions without answers. Use it when the user wants to practise for GATE CS, solve questions, or keep a daily study habit. Leave out date for today's set.

date.description: A past set's date, YYYY-MM-DD (IST). Leave out for today's set.
